priorityList: Use Takedown and all offensive cooldowns (Trinkets, Racials, Potions) together.
Cast Kill Command if Tip of the Spear is below 2 stacks and you have any Pack Leader buff (Wyvern, Boar, or Bear active).
Cast Kill Command if Takedown is nearly ready and you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Takedown if you have at least 1 stack of Tip of the Spear (or 0 stacks if talented into Twin Fangs).
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you are about to reach maximum charges to avoid capping.
Cast Boomstick whenever you have at least 1 stack of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Wildfire Bomb whenever you have at least 1 stack of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) to maintain your Raptor Swipe cleave buff or whenever you have Tip of the Spear.
Cast Kill Command as your primary generator while Takedown is on cooldown.
Cast Wildfire Bomb as a filler if available.
Cast Aspect of the Eagle if you are forced out of melee range of your targets.
